label: prf:qou-exists-axiom-1
title: Proof of axiom 1 (Frobenius pairing) for QOU existence
html: Proof. The Haar state h = \int_{A} is faithful: for any non-zero a \in A there exists b \in A with h(ab) \neq 0. This is the content of Woronowicz's reconstruction theorem [woronowicz1987]. Faithfulness is equivalent to non-degeneracy of (a, b) \mapsto h(ab), which yields the isomorphism A \xrightarrow{\sim} A^{\vee} required by axiom~(1). \square
heading: Proof
